description: Armour weight (D592; D776: stamina is back, so weight also prices the roll and the stamina refill), read by Scripts/Systems/ArmourWeight.gd. The worn body armour's items.json "weight" sets the class; no body armour is medium (the plain roll). roll_length = share added to the roll's length; defense = flat Phys. Def. added to the equipment stats; roll_stamina = share added to the roll's stamina cost; stamina_regen = share added to the stamina refill rate. Numbers are provisional (design/charms_plan.md), checked against verify_difficulty (D642).
